findings.the_shape_is_the_finding: ⭐ NOT ONE DEFECT IS A WRONG NUMBER. The arithmetic seat re-derived 140 printed quantities — all 44 arm records, all 13 Fisher p-values, every Wilson bound, every additive identity — with ZERO mismatches, using its own implementations rather than the generator's, and ran emc_fusion_partner_pooling.py --check, the 122-test prose guard and the 9-test mutation suite clean.
